name: ITONICS Innovation OS
description: Cloud-based innovation management platform that supports trend scouting, technology radar, idea management, and portfolio roadmapping for organizations navigating uncertain future landscapes. It aggregates weak signals and expert input to support strategic decision-making under ambiguity. The platform is used commercially rather than as an academic benchmark.
reputation: Widely adopted by large enterprises and innovation teams for horizon scanning and portfolio management; not a standard academic benchmark.
notes: Commercial SaaS product rather than an open benchmark; evaluation is qualitative and organisation-specific. No standardised scoring exists.
